observations.why: First-person plural declarative enacts a collective decision stance — the speaker commits the group to a course of action, performing authority through adoption.
Proportionality framing — performance gain quantified as a cost-benefit ratio, the relational move of justifying choice by measured return.
Speaker sets a timeline for the collective — a scheduling commitment that enacts authority over when the group moves.
Bulleted allocation of a tool to a function — proportionate matching of resource to purpose; the list format itself enacts a cost-benefit accounting stance.
Quantified performance gain restated as proportionality — the relational move of justifying the decision by measured return.
Timeline commitment restated — speaker sets the group's schedule, enacting authority over collective timing.
